candidate.name: tbrowse
candidate.notes: Flat node table + pluggable row-aligned zones; SVG tree zone, DOM label/column zones, canvas MSA zone; native-scroll virtualised rows, no zoom.

tipClick.how: click on a leaf row, branch or label sets ViewState.selectedNodeId (library state); the adapter turns the change into a tipClick event

internalNodeClick.how: click on an internal branch or collapsed triangle sets ViewState.selectedNodeId; the library also opens its own tooltip with collapse / prune / swap / reroot actions

branchClick.how: the branch hit path IS the click target of its child node; branch and node clicks are the same event (reported as nodeClick)

hover.how: ZoneRenderProps.hoveredNodeId inside our own zone body (fires only while that zone is visible); not available through TBrowseProps

descendantTipsInPayload.how: the library reports only a node id (selectedNodeId); tip sets are computed from the shared TreeModel and flagged source=adapter-derived (hoveredSubtreeIds exists but only in zone render props)

cladeColouring.how: no colour prop in the library: inline style patched on the tree SVG branches and leaf dots (path d parsed back to a node through mirrored row geometry) plus React-rendered colour in our tips and column zones; internal-node glyphs and dashed leaders stay grey; re-patched by a MutationObserver

highlightTip.how: library search state (host SearchField) draws a ring on the leaf dot and marks collapsed triangles; our zones add a row band; typing in the library search box replaces it

focusTip.how: scrolls the library .tbrowse-outer scroll container to centre the row (DOM access, no API); un-collapses and un-prunes ancestors through ViewState first

tipAsLink.how: real <a href data-tip-id target=_blank> rendered by our own label zone (ZoneDefinition) for rows in the virtualised range; the built-in labels zone has no links

customColumns.how: one ZoneDefinition per column (Header + Body from ZoneRenderProps.visibleRows/rowRange, data via the hostData prop); rows stay aligned because every zone shares the same row grid

alignmentColumn.how: built-in msaZone fed from MSA {alphabet,length,sequences} keyed by geneId = tip label; canvas is as tall as ALL rows, so it goes blank beyond the browser canvas limit (about 1,365 rows at 24 px, source-derived); one alignment only

branchLengthToggle.how: TreeZoneState.layoutMode phylogram | cladogram through controlled viewState; adapter rescales lengths (absolute 0.01 floor in the library); optional // compression of long branches is a separate toggle

scaleBar.how: no scale bar or time axis in the tree zone

darkTheme.how: theme="dark" prop plus CSS custom properties (--tbrowse-*) re-pointed at gbifDarkTheme() values

cssTokens.how: --tbrowse-* custom properties on .tbrowse-root take GBIF token values (bg, text, branch, accent, borders); fixed in code: selection amber, branch width by clade size, glyph sizes, residue colours; no per-node style callbacks

multipleInstances.how: zustand store per <TBrowse>; only global is one injected <style id=tbrowse-theme-style>

cleanUnmount.how: React unmount; the document keydown listener for the search hotkey is removed (and disabled here with hotkeys={{search:false}})

controlledState.how: viewState / onViewStateChange (selection, collapse, prune, swap, zone widths and states, search, row height) controlled from React state

zoomToFit.how: no zoom: fixed 24 px rows in a native scroll container. ViewState.rowHeight can be set to fit all rows (the "fit" row-height option) but then every row, SVG node and label is drawn (no culling benefit)

overviewOrMinimap.how: no minimap or semantic zoom; collapsedNodeIds turns clades into triangle rows (the adapter "overview" option picks them), the MSA zone has its own coverage minimap

caveat: Headless Chromium without a GPU (SwiftShader software rendering): absolute FPS for canvas and WebGL candidates is pessimistic; use for functional tests and relative comparison. Final scale numbers need a real browser on a normal laptop.
